name: cropotter
description: Format shipping-label PDFs as reviewed 4 by 6 inch PDF, PNG and ZIP files using the bundled CropOtter engine in your ChatGPT workspace.

interface.longDescription: Turn an attached shipping-label PDF into a portrait 4 by 6 inch PDF, PNG or ZIP. Uses the same CropOtter engine as the website, preserves proportions and minimum white margins, and withholds uncertain crops for deliberate review. Requires a ChatGPT execution environment with Node.js 24+, npm, first-use public npm access and supported native canvas dependencies. Files are processed in the caller's execution environment, not on a CropOtter conversion server. Your ChatGPT plan, usage limits, environment permissions and OpenAI data settings still apply. No CropOtter account, model API key or new owner-hosted conversion service is required. Direct printing and arbitrary PDF editing are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Format my attached shipping-label PDF as 4 × 6 PDF and PNG.
Try CropOtter with its bundled synthetic sample label.
